LLM-PRICING CHECK v2 (2026-10-05)
- Per-provider Perplexity lookups (sonar-pro, domain-filtered to the table's own source hosts + official pages): price/lifecycle for table models, and a separate NEW-MODEL lookup that is told which models are already known.
- Compare: price drift (>=5%), deprecations/shutdown dates, NEW MODELS with predecessor + blended-price recommendation (3:1 in:out; CHEAPER if >=10% less), cheaper successors already in the table, and COVERAGE GAPS for failed lookups.
- Trigger set explicitly to the 1st at 07:30 SGT (deployed v1 was 04:30 with no day set).
- Still never edits the table; a warning row = Tom triage + Sable PR.
- v2 also: non-text models ignored, max 25 candidates, stale-verification note (>90d), NEXT STEP line pointing to /llm-pricing-triage. Cheaper-model recommendations inform triage but do not by themselves set status to Pending.
